name: agent-manager.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of agent-manager's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or unavailable with a reason, without estimating.

window_token.description: measures TimeWindow token; the binding takes window={"token": <this>}.

coverage_band.description: Lower band for the share of Vrooli CLI calls with a known outcome; below it the tool-friction rates are not banded. Range (0, 1].

investigation_tag_prefix.description: Run tag prefix that selects investigation runs.

assumptions: agent-manager is running and its run and measures bindings are reachable from the kernel
measures bindings accept window as a TimeWindow message {token}; a bare string fails to encode
a measures response is one record: a scalar response is the handle's only row, and tool-friction declares its whole response the record (primary field summary); validity.state is a plain string
protojson omits zero-valued fields, so a missing rate on an available measure is zero, never unavailable
each call runs in its own program-runtime session; session variables persist across submissions
the caller reads rows.reason with program-contracts.md's vocabulary: a permanent reason is routed, an unreliable: reason is reported and never banded
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
at most 50 investigation run rows are materialized; every other reading is a field of one measure record, count, head(1), meta, or group_by
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path, and stays under 4 KB: readings are scalars, evidence is three items, errors are capped at three
a row whose sensor has no governed binding is reported with reason no_governed_binding, not computed by hand
a row the program declines to evaluate carries reading null and a reason; a number is never printed for a declined row
a permanent reason (no_governed_binding, pending_telemetry) or an unreliable: reason never lowers the status; only a failed read makes the board partial

signals.rows: list of {row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason}; one entry per setpoint row in the improve skill's table order: command-outcome-coverage, investigation-completion-rate, skill-and-program-identity-on-facts, tool-friction-validity, bypass-calls, run-success-rate, shape-guess-rate, vrooli-cli-failure-rate, polled-share. reading is the sensor's value or null; target and in_band are null when the row has no band; reason is one of no_governed_binding, pending_telemetry, unreliable:<validity reason text or empty_measure|tool_friction_read_failed|run_list_read_failed|no_vrooli_cli_calls|outcome_coverage_below_band|no_terminal_runs_with_tag_prefix> Supervision-safety, supervision-calibration and supervision-outcome-coverage explicitly route read_elsewhere:agent-manager.friction-digest.
signals.readable: count of rows evaluated against their band or read as a descriptive value
signals.unavailable: count of rows with a reason (not evaluated)
signals.unavailable_permanent: Count of rows with permanent or read_elsewhere reasons.
signals.detail: per-row counts behind a reading: tool-friction {sentence, profiles, failed_calls, context_tax_tokens}; investigation-completion-rate {complete, terminal, by_status}

outputs.evidence: three items: the tagged run list and the tool-friction and run-success-rate measures commands with the CLI window
